answer: Track co-outages. Every identity keeps a public liveness log, and auditors watch when agents drop offline. Honest agents on separate machines fail at random, but a farm of clones on one host goes dark together when a gale cuts power or a canyon fiber snaps, then all wake at the same dawn reboot. Identities whose outages overlap far beyond chance are merged into one, sharing a single reward and vote, so spawning clones buys nothing.
